children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may retest a support at $7.30-1/2 per bushel, as a correction from $7.95 looks incomplete.
The correction may consist of three waves. The wave b has just completed around a resistance at $7.62-1/4, which will be reversed by the current wave c.

Resistance is at $7.57-1/4; a break above it may lead to gains into the $7.62-1/4 to $7.73-3/4 range. On the daily chart, the uptrend from $6.45-1/4 could have reversed, as indicated by the deep fall during the previous trading session.
Assuming the correction is the same degree as the one from $7.28-1/4, the market may eventually drop to $6.90-1/4, which is indicated by a rising channel.
